sourceCopy.name: Mortgage Affordability Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Mortgage Affordability Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Estimate a home-price range from income, debts, down payment, rate, taxes and insurance. Free, browser-based, with no account.
sourceCopy.intro: Estimate a possible home-price ceiling from the monthly housing budget and assumptions you enter. See principal, interest, property tax, insurance and HOA costs separately.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I estimate how much house I can afford?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Enter gross monthly income, monthly debts, a total debt-to-income limit and housing-cost assumptions. The estimate solves for a price whose modeled monthly debt and housing costs match that limit.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Are my income or debt details uploaded?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. This calculation runs in your browser; the values you enter are not uploaded or saved by this tool.

fields.assumptionsNote: Enter your own estimates. Gross income is before taxes. This uses a user-selected total debt-to-income limit; it is not a lender approval rule.
fields.costNote: Monthly housing includes principal and interest, estimated property tax, homeowners insurance, HOA fees and the optional mortgage-insurance amount you enter. Maintenance, utilities, closing costs and other expenses are not included.
fields.accuracyNote: Illustrative estimate only, not financial advice, a loan offer, eligibility decision or guarantee. Lenders use additional information and rules. Rates, taxes, insurance, fees and costs vary. Check local figures and consult a qualified housing or mortgage professional before making a decision.
fields.monthlyBudget: Monthly housing budget after other debts
fields.sourceLinkText: Read the CFPB home payment worksheet

messages.calculated: Illustrative estimate calculated from your assumptions.
messages.checkInputs: Check income, debts, down payment and housing-cost assumptions.
messages.copyUnavailable: Copy is unavailable in this browser.

additionalFaqs.question: What costs are included in the monthly housing estimate?
additionalFaqs.answer: Principal and interest, estimated property tax, homeowners insurance, HOA or condo fees, and any monthly mortgage-insurance amount you enter. The estimate does not include maintenance, utilities or closing costs.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this estimate mean a lender will approve me?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It is arithmetic based on your assumptions, not a lender decision. Lenders may review credit, assets, employment, loan terms, property details and other rules.

additionalFaqs.question: Why does a higher monthly debt amount lower the home-price estimate?
additionalFaqs.answer: The selected total debt-to-income limit is shared by housing costs and other debt payments. More monthly debt leaves less of that modeled budget for housing.
